name: 10603 · White Plains, NY
findings: ZIP 10603 (White Plains) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10603 (White Plains) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10603 (White Plains) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
